verses.textZh: 奉神旨意，凭着在基督耶稣里的生命的应许，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，
verses.textZhCnvs: 奉神旨意，凭着在基督耶稣里的生命的应许，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，
verses.textZhCuv: 奉神旨意，照着在基督耶稣里生命的应许，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, in keeping with the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God according to the promise of the life that is in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, chosen by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. I have been sent out to tell others about the life he has promised through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEn: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, in keeping with the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,

verses.textZh: 写信给亲爱的儿子提摩太，愿恩惠、怜悯、平安从父神和我们的主基督耶稣临到你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 写信给亲爱的儿子提摩太，愿恩惠、怜悯、平安从父神和我们的主基督耶稣临到你。
verses.textZhCuv: 写信给我亲爱的儿子提摩太。愿恩惠、怜悯、平安从父神和我们主基督耶稣归与你！
verses.textEnNiv: To Timothy, my dear son: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: To Timothy, a beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing to Timothy, my dear son. May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord give you grace, mercy, and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: To Timothy, my beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEn: To Timothy, my dear son: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.textZh: 我感谢神，就是我像我祖先一样，以清洁的良心所事奉的神，在祷告中昼夜不断地记念你；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我感谢神，就是我像我祖先一样，以清洁的良心所事奉的神，在祷告中昼夜不断地记念你；
verses.textZhCuv: 我感谢神，就是我接续祖先用清洁的良心所事奉的神。祈祷的时候，不住的想念你，
verses.textEnNiv: I thank God, whom I serve, as my ancestors did, with a clear conscience, as night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.
verses.textEnEsv: I thank God whom I serve, as did my ancestors, with a clear conscience, as I remember you constantly in my prayers night and day.
verses.textEnNkjv: I thank God, whom I serve with a pure conscience, as my forefathers did, as without ceasing I remember you in my prayers night and day,
verses.textEnNlt: Timothy, I thank God for you—the God I serve with a clear conscience, just as my ancestors did. Night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.
verses.textEnNasb: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience the way my forefathers did, as I constantly remember you in my prayers night and day,
verses.textEn: I thank God, whom I serve, as my ancestors did, with a clear conscience, as night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.

verses.textZh: 一想起你流的眼泪，我就渴望见你，好叫我满有喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一想起你流的眼泪，我就渴望见你，好叫我满有喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 记念你的眼泪，昼夜切切地想要见你，好叫我满心快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Recalling your tears, I long to see you, so that I may be filled with joy.
verses.textEnEsv: As I remember your tears, I long to see you, that I may be filled with joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: greatly desiring to see you, being mindful of your tears, that I may be filled with joy,
verses.textEnNlt: I long to see you again, for I remember your tears as we parted. And I will be filled with joy when we are together again.
verses.textEnNasb: longing to see you, even as I recall your tears, so that I may be filled with joy.
verses.textEn: Recalling your tears, I long to see you, so that I may be filled with joy.

verses.textZh: 我记得你心里无伪的信心，这信心原先是在你外祖母罗以和你母亲友尼基心里的，我深信也在你的心里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我记得你心里无伪的信心，这信心原先是在你外祖母罗以和你母亲友尼基心里的，我深信也在你的心里。
verses.textZhCuv: 想到你心里无伪之信，这信是先在你外祖母罗以和你母亲友妮基心里的，我深信也在你的心里。
verses.textEnNiv: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, now lives in you also.
verses.textEnEsv: I am reminded of your sincere faith, a faith that dwelt first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and now, I am sure, dwells in you as well.
verses.textEnNkjv: when I call to remembrance the genuine faith that is in you, which dwelt first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am persuaded is in you also.
verses.textEnNlt: I remember your genuine faith, for you share the faith that first filled your grandmother Lois and your mother, Eunice. And I know that same faith continues strong in you.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am mindful of the sincere faith within you, which first dwelled in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am sure that it is in you as well.
verses.textEn: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, now lives in you also.

verses.textZh: 为了这缘故，我提醒你，要把神借着我按手给你的恩赐，像火一样再挑旺起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了这缘故，我提醒你，要把神借着我按手给你的恩赐，像火一样再挑旺起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 为此我提醒你，使你将神藉我按手所给你的恩赐再如火挑旺起来。
verses.textEnNiv: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
verses.textEnEsv: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I remind you to stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
verses.textEnNlt: This is why I remind you to fan into flames the spiritual gift God gave you when I laid my hands on you.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason I remind you to kindle afresh the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
verses.textEn: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

verses.textZh: 因为神所赐给我们的，不是胆怯的灵，而是有能力、仁爱、自律的灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神所赐给我们的，不是胆怯的灵，而是有能力、仁爱、自律的灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神赐给我们，不是胆怯的心，乃是刚强、仁爱、谨守的心。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.
verses.textEnEsv: for God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control.
verses.textEnNkjv: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.
verses.textEnNlt: For God has not given us a spirit of fear and timidity, but of power, love, and self-discipline.
verses.textEnNasb: For God has not given us a spirit of timidity, but of power and love and discipline.
verses.textEn: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.

verses.textZh: 所以，不要以给我们的主作见证当作羞耻，也不要以我这为主被囚的当作羞耻，却要为了福音的缘故，靠着神的大能，与我同受磨难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，不要以给我们的主作见证当作羞耻，也不要以我这为主被囚的当作羞耻，却要为了福音的缘故，靠着神的大能，与我同受磨难。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要以给我们的主作见证为耻，也不要以我这为主被囚的为耻；总要按神的能力，与我为福音同受苦难。
verses.textEnNiv: So do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord or of me his prisoner. Rather, join with me in suffering for the gospel, by the power of God.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord, nor of me his prisoner, but share in suffering for the gospel by the power of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me His prisoner, but share with me in the sufferings for the gospel according to the power of God,
verses.textEnNlt: So never be ashamed to tell others about our Lord. And don’t be ashamed of me, either, even though I’m in prison for him. With the strength God gives you, be ready to suffer with me for the sake of the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord or of me His prisoner, but join with me in suffering for the gospel according to the power of God,
verses.textEn: So do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord or of me his prisoner. Rather, join with me in suffering for the gospel, by the power of God.

verses.textZh: 神救了我们，以圣召呼召我们，不是按照我们的行为，却是按照他自己的计划和恩典；这恩典是在万世以前，在基督耶稣里赐给了我们的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神救了我们，以圣召呼召我们，不是按照我们的行为，却是按照他自己的计划和恩典；这恩典是在万世以前，在基督耶稣里赐给了我们的，
verses.textZhCuv: 神救了我们，以圣召召我们，不是按我们的行为，乃是按他的旨意和恩典；这恩典是万古之先，在基督耶稣里赐给我们的，
verses.textEnNiv: He has saved us and called us to a holy life—not because of anything we have done but because of his own purpose and grace. This grace was given us in Christ Jesus before the beginning of time,
verses.textEnEsv: who saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works but because of his own purpose and grace, which he gave us in Christ Jesus before the ages began,
verses.textEnNkjv: who has saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to His own purpose and grace which was given to us in Christ Jesus before time began,
verses.textEnNlt: For God saved us and called us to live a holy life. He did this, not because we deserved it, but because that was his plan from before the beginning of time—to show us his grace through Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to His own purpose and grace, which was granted to us in Christ Jesus from all eternity,
verses.textEn: He has saved us and called us to a holy life—not because of anything we have done but because of his own purpose and grace. This grace was given us in Christ Jesus before the beginning of time,

verses.textZh: 但现在借着我们救主基督耶稣的显现，才表明出来。他废掉了死亡，借着福音把生命和不朽彰显出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在借着我们救主基督耶稣的显现，才表明出来。他废掉了死亡，借着福音把生命和不朽彰显出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今藉着我们救主基督耶稣的显现才表明出来了。他已经把死废去，藉着福音，将不能坏的生命彰显出来。
verses.textEnNiv: but it has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has destroyed death and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.
verses.textEnEsv: and which now has been manifested through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,
verses.textEnNkjv: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior Jesus Christ, who has abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,
verses.textEnNlt: And now he has made all of this plain to us by the appearing of Christ Jesus, our Savior. He broke the power of death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,
verses.textEn: but it has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has destroyed death and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

verses.textZh: 为这福音，我被派作传道的、使徒和教师。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为这福音，我被派作传道的、使徒和教师。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为这福音奉派作传道的，作使徒，作师傅。
verses.textEnNiv: And of this gospel I was appointed a herald and an apostle and a teacher.
verses.textEnEsv: for which I was appointed a preacher and apostle and teacher,
verses.textEnNkjv: to which I was appointed a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: And God chose me to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of this Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: for which I was appointed a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
verses.textEn: And of this gospel I was appointed a herald and an apostle and a teacher.

verses.textZh: 为了这缘故，我也受这些苦，但我不以为耻，因为我知道我所信的是谁，也深信他能保守我所交托他的 ，直到那日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了这缘故，我也受这些苦，但我不以为耻，因为我知道我所信的是谁，也深信他能保守我所交托他的 ，直到那日。
verses.textZhCuv: 为这缘故，我也受这些苦难。然而我不以为耻；因为知道我所信的是谁，也深信他能保全我所交付他的 ，直到那日。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why I am suffering as I am. Yet this is no cause for shame, because I know whom I have believed, and am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until that day.
verses.textEnEsv: which is why I suffer as I do. But I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that he is able to guard until that day what has been entrusted to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason I also suffer these things; nevertheless I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed and am persuaded that He is able to keep what I have committed to Him until that Day.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I am suffering here in prison. But I am not ashamed of it, for I know the one in whom I trust, and I am sure that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until the day of his return.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason I also suffer these things; but I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to protect what I have entrusted to Him until that day.
verses.textEn: That is why I am suffering as I am. Yet this is no cause for shame, because I know whom I have believed, and am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until that day.

verses.textZh: 你要靠着在基督耶稣里的信心和爱心，常常坚守从我这里听过的话，作为纯正话语的模范；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要靠着在基督耶稣里的信心和爱心，常常坚守从我这里听过的话，作为纯正话语的模范；
verses.textZhCuv: 你从我听的那纯正话语的规模，要用在基督耶稣里的信心和爱心，常常守着。
verses.textEnNiv: What you heard from me, keep as the pattern of sound teaching, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Follow the pattern of the sound words that you have heard from me, in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hold fast the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which are in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Hold on to the pattern of wholesome teaching you learned from me—a pattern shaped by the faith and love that you have in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Hold on to the example of sound words which you have heard from me, in the faith and love which are in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: What you heard from me, keep as the pattern of sound teaching, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 又要靠着那住在我们里面的圣灵，保守所交托你的善道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要靠着那住在我们里面的圣灵，保守所交托你的善道。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前所交托你的善道，你要靠着那住在我们里面的圣灵牢牢地守着。
verses.textEnNiv: Guard the good deposit that was entrusted to you—guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit who lives in us.
verses.textEnEsv: By the Holy Spirit who dwells within us, guard the good deposit entrusted to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: That good thing which was committed to you, keep by the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
verses.textEnNlt: Through the power of the Holy Spirit who lives within us, carefully guard the precious truth that has been entrusted to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Protect, through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us, the treasure which has been entrusted to you.
verses.textEn: Guard the good deposit that was entrusted to you—guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit who lives in us.

verses.textZh: 你知道所有在亚西亚的人都离弃了我，他们当中有腓吉路和黑摩其尼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你知道所有在亚西亚的人都离弃了我，他们当中有腓吉路和黑摩其尼。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在亚细亚的人都离弃我，这是你知道的，其中有腓吉路和黑摩其尼。
verses.textEnNiv: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
verses.textEnEsv: You are aware that all who are in Asia turned away from me, among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
verses.textEnNkjv: This you know, that all those in Asia have turned away from me, among whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
verses.textEnNlt: As you know, everyone from the province of Asia has deserted me—even Phygelus and Hermogenes.
verses.textEnNasb: You are aware of the fact that all who are in Asia turned away from me, among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
verses.textEn: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.

verses.textZh: 愿主赐怜悯给阿尼色弗一家的人，因为他多次使我畅快，也不以我的锁炼为耻；
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿主赐怜悯给阿尼色弗一家的人，因为他多次使我畅快，也不以我的锁炼为耻；
verses.textZhCuv: 愿主怜悯阿尼色弗一家的人；因他屡次使我畅快，不以我的锁链为耻，
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord show mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains.
verses.textEnEsv: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain;
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord show special kindness to Onesiphorus and all his family because he often visited and encouraged me. He was never ashamed of me because I was in chains.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains;
verses.textEn: May the Lord show mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains.

verses.textZh: 他竟然来到罗马，迫切地寻找我，结果找到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他竟然来到罗马，迫切地寻找我，结果找到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 反倒在罗马的时候，殷勤地找我，并且找着了。
verses.textEnNiv: On the contrary, when he was in Rome, he searched hard for me until he found me.
verses.textEnEsv: but when he arrived in Rome he searched for me earnestly and found me—
verses.textEnNkjv: but when he arrived in Rome, he sought me out very zealously and found me.
verses.textEnNlt: When he came to Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
verses.textEnNasb: but when he was in Rome, he eagerly searched for me and found me—
verses.textEn: On the contrary, when he was in Rome, he searched hard for me until he found me.

verses.textZh: 你也清楚知道他在以弗所是怎样多方服事我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也清楚知道他在以弗所是怎样多方服事我。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿主使他在那日得主的怜悯。他在以弗所怎样多多地服事我，是你明明知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord grant that he will find mercy from the Lord on that day! You know very well in how many ways he helped me in Ephesus.
verses.textEnEsv: may the Lord grant him to find mercy from the Lord on that day!—and you well know all the service he rendered at Ephesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord grant to him that he may find mercy from the Lord in that Day—and you know very well how many ways he ministered tome at Ephesus.
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord show him special kindness on the day of Christ’s return. And you know very well how helpful he was in Ephesus.
verses.textEnNasb: the Lord grant to him to find mercy from the Lord on that day—and you know very well what services he rendered at Ephesus.
verses.textEn: May the Lord grant that he will find mercy from the Lord on that day! You know very well in how many ways he helped me in Ephesus.

verses.textZh: 所以，我儿啊，你应当在基督耶稣的恩典里刚强起来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我儿啊，你应当在基督耶稣的恩典里刚强起来，
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿啊，你要在基督耶稣的恩典上刚强起来。
verses.textEnNiv: You then, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: You then, my child, be strengthened by the grace that is in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: You therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Timothy, my dear son, be strong through the grace that God gives you in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: You therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: You then, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 又应当把你在许多见证人面前从我这里听见的，交托给那些又忠心又能够教导别人的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又应当把你在许多见证人面前从我这里听见的，交托给那些又忠心又能够教导别人的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在许多见证人面前听见我所教训的，也要交托那忠心能教导别人的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable people who will also be qualified to teach others.
verses.textEnEsv: and what you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses entrust to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the things that you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit these to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
verses.textEnNlt: You have heard me teach things that have been confirmed by many reliable witnesses. Now teach these truths to other trustworthy people who will be able to pass them on to others.
verses.textEnNasb: The things which you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses, entrust these to faithful people who will be able to teach others also.
verses.textEn: And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable people who will also be qualified to teach others.

verses.textZh: 你应当和我同受磨难，好象基督耶稣的精兵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你应当和我同受磨难，好象基督耶稣的精兵。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要和我同受苦难，好像基督耶稣的精兵。
verses.textEnNiv: Join with me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Endure suffering along with me, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Suffer hardship with me, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: Join with me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 当兵的人不让世务缠身，为要使那招兵的人欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当兵的人不让世务缠身，为要使那招兵的人欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在军中当兵的，不将世务缠身，好叫那招他当兵的人喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: No one serving as a soldier gets entangled in civilian affairs, but rather tries to please his commanding officer.
verses.textEnEsv: No soldier gets entangled in civilian pursuits, since his aim is to please the one who enlisted him.
verses.textEnNkjv: No one engaged in warfare entangles himself with the affairs of this life, that he may please him who enlisted him as a soldier.
verses.textEnNlt: Soldiers don’t get tied up in the affairs of civilian life, for then they cannot please the officer who enlisted them.
verses.textEnNasb: No soldier in active service entangles himself in the affairs of everyday life, so that he may please the one who enlisted him.
verses.textEn: No one serving as a soldier gets entangled in civilian affairs, but rather tries to please his commanding officer.

verses.textZh: 竞赛的人若不遵守规则，就不能得冠冕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 竞赛的人若不遵守规则，就不能得冠冕。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若在场上比武，非按规矩，就不能得冠冕。
verses.textEnNiv: Similarly, anyone who competes as an athlete does not receive the victor’s crown except by competing according to the rules.
verses.textEnEsv: An athlete is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: And also if anyone competes in athletics, he is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules.
verses.textEnNlt: And athletes cannot win the prize unless they follow the rules.
verses.textEnNasb: And if someone likewise competes as an athlete, he is not crowned as victor unless he competes according to the rules.
verses.textEn: Similarly, anyone who competes as an athlete does not receive the victor’s crown except by competing according to the rules.

verses.textZh: 劳力的农夫理当先尝果实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 劳力的农夫理当先尝果实。
verses.textZhCuv: 劳力的农夫理当先得粮食。
verses.textEnNiv: The hardworking farmer should be the first to receive a share of the crops.
verses.textEnEsv: It is the hard-working farmer who ought to have the first share of the crops.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hardworking farmer must be first to partake of the crops.
verses.textEnNlt: And hardworking farmers should be the first to enjoy the fruit of their labor.
verses.textEnNasb: The hard-working farmer ought to be the first to receive his share of the crops.
verses.textEn: The hardworking farmer should be the first to receive a share of the crops.

verses.textZh: 你要想想我的话，因为凡事主必给你领悟力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要想想我的话，因为凡事主必给你领悟力。
verses.textZhCuv: 我所说的话，你要思想，因为凡事主必给你聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: Reflect on what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all this.
verses.textEnEsv: Think over what I say, for the Lord will give you understanding in everything.
verses.textEnNkjv: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
verses.textEnNlt: Think about what I am saying. The Lord will help you understand all these things.
verses.textEnNasb: Consider what I say, for the Lord will give you understanding in everything.
verses.textEn: Reflect on what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all this.

verses.textZh: 你要记得那从死人中复活的耶稣基督，他是大卫的后裔所生的，这就是我所传的福音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要记得那从死人中复活的耶稣基督，他是大卫的后裔所生的，这就是我所传的福音。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要记念耶稣基督乃是大卫的后裔，他从死里复活，正合乎我所传的福音。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David. This is my gospel,
verses.textEnEsv: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, the offspring of David, as preached in my gospel,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember that Jesus Christ, of the seed of David, was raised from the dead according to my gospel,
verses.textEnNlt: Always remember that Jesus Christ, a descendant of King David, was raised from the dead. This is the Good News I preach.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, descendant of David, according to my gospel,
verses.textEn: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David. This is my gospel,

verses.textZh: 我为了这福音受了磨难，甚至像犯人一样被捆绑起来；可是，神的话却不被捆绑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我为了这福音受了磨难，甚至像犯人一样被捆绑起来；可是，神的话却不被捆绑。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为这福音受苦难，甚至被捆绑，像犯人一样。然而神的道却不被捆绑。
verses.textEnNiv: for which I am suffering even to the point of being chained like a criminal. But God’s word is not chained.
verses.textEnEsv: for which I am suffering, bound with chains as a criminal. But the word of God is not bound!
verses.textEnNkjv: for which I suffer trouble as an evildoer, even to the point of chains; but the word of God is not chained.
verses.textEnNlt: And because I preach this Good News, I am suffering and have been chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained.
verses.textEnNasb: for which I suffer hardship even to imprisonment as a criminal; but the word of God is not imprisoned.
verses.textEn: for which I am suffering even to the point of being chained like a criminal. But God’s word is not chained.

verses.textZh: 因此，我为了选民忍受一切，好叫他们也可以得着在基督耶稣里的救恩，和永远的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我为了选民忍受一切，好叫他们也可以得着在基督耶稣里的救恩，和永远的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我为选民凡事忍耐，叫他们也可以得着那在基督耶稣里的救恩和永远的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the elect, that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the elect, that they also may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.textEnNlt: So I am willing to endure anything if it will bring salvation and eternal glory in Christ Jesus to those God has chosen.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of those who are chosen, so that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus and with it eternal glory.
verses.textEn: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the elect, that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.

verses.textZh: "我们若与基督同死，就必与他同活；
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们若与基督同死，就必与他同活；
verses.textZhCuv: 有可信的话说： 我们若与基督同死，也必与他同活；
verses.textEnNiv: Here is a trustworthy saying: If we died with him, we will also live with him;
verses.textEnEsv: The saying is trustworthy, for: If we have died with him, we will also live with him;
verses.textEnNkjv: Thisis a faithful saying: For if we died with Him, We shall also live with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: This is a trustworthy saying: If we die with him, we will also live with him.
verses.textEnNasb: The statement is trustworthy: For if we died with Him, we will also live with Him;
verses.textEn: Here is a trustworthy saying: If we died with him, we will also live with him;

verses.textZh: 我们若能坚忍，就必与他一同作王； 我们若不认他，他必不认我们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若能坚忍，就必与他一同作王； 我们若不认他，他必不认我们；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若能忍耐，也必和他一同作王。 我们若不认他，他也必不认我们；
verses.textEnNiv: if we endure, we will also reign with him. If we disown him, he will also disown us;
verses.textEnEsv: if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he also will deny us;
verses.textEnNkjv: If we endure, We shall also reign with Him. If we deny Him, He also will deny us.
verses.textEnNlt: If we endure hardship, we will reign with him. If we deny him, he will deny us.
verses.textEnNasb: If we endure, we will also reign with Him; If we deny Him, He will also deny us;
verses.textEn: if we endure, we will also reign with him. If we disown him, he will also disown us;

verses.textZh: 我们纵然不信，他仍然是信实的， 因为他不能否定自己。" 这话是可信的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们纵然不信，他仍然是信实的， 因为他不能否定自己。" 这话是可信的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们纵然失信，他仍是可信的， 因为他不能背乎自己。
verses.textEnNiv: if we are faithless, he remains faithful, for he cannot disown himself.
verses.textEnEsv: if we are faithless, he remains faithful— for he cannot deny himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: If we are faithless, He remains faithful; He cannot deny Himself.
verses.textEnNlt: If we are unfaithful, he remains faithful, for he cannot deny who he is.
verses.textEnNasb: If we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself.
verses.textEn: if we are faithless, he remains faithful, for he cannot disown himself.

verses.textZh: 你要在神面前把这些事提醒众人，叮嘱他们不要作无益的争辩；这只能败坏听见的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在神面前把这些事提醒众人，叮嘱他们不要作无益的争辩；这只能败坏听见的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要使众人回想这些事，在主面前嘱咐他们：不可为言语争辩；这是没有益处的，只能败坏听见的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep reminding God’s people of these things. Warn them before God against quarreling about words; it is of no value, and only ruins those who listen.
verses.textEnEsv: Remind them of these things, and charge them before God not to quarrel about words, which does no good, but only ruins the hearers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remind them of these things, charging them before the Lord not to strive about words to no profit, to the ruin of the hearers.
verses.textEnNlt: Remind everyone about these things, and command them in God’s presence to stop fighting over words. Such arguments are useless, and they can ruin those who hear them.
verses.textEnNasb: Remind them of these things, and solemnly exhort them in the presence of God not to dispute about words, which is useless and leads to the ruin of the listeners.
verses.textEn: Keep reminding God’s people of these things. Warn them before God against quarreling about words; it is of no value, and only ruins those who listen.

verses.textZh: 你应当竭力在神面前作一个蒙称许、无愧的工人，正确地讲解真理的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你应当竭力在神面前作一个蒙称许、无愧的工人，正确地讲解真理的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当竭力在神面前得蒙喜悦，作无愧的工人，按着正意分解真理的道。
verses.textEnNiv: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly handles the word of truth.
verses.textEnEsv: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God, a worker who does not need to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.textEnNlt: Work hard so you can present yourself to God and receive his approval. Be a good worker, one who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly explains the word of truth.
verses.textEnNasb: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God as a worker who does not need to be ashamed, accurately handling the word of truth.
verses.textEn: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly handles the word of truth.

verses.textZh: 总要远避世俗的空谈，因为这些必会引人进到更不敬虔的地步。
verses.textZhCnvs: 总要远避世俗的空谈，因为这些必会引人进到更不敬虔的地步。
verses.textZhCuv: 但要远避世俗的虚谈，因为这等人必进到更不敬虔的地步。
verses.textEnNiv: Avoid godless chatter, because those who indulge in it will become more and more ungodly.
verses.textEnEsv: But avoid irreverent babble, for it will lead people into more and more ungodliness,
verses.textEnNkjv: But shun profane and idle babblings, for they will increase to more ungodliness.
verses.textEnNlt: Avoid worthless, foolish talk that only leads to more godless behavior.
verses.textEnNasb: But avoid worldly and empty chatter, for it will lead to further ungodliness,
verses.textEn: Avoid godless chatter, because those who indulge in it will become more and more ungodly.

verses.textZh: 他们的话好象毒瘤一样蔓延；他们当中有许米乃和腓理徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的话好象毒瘤一样蔓延；他们当中有许米乃和腓理徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的话如同毒疮，越烂越大；其中有许米乃和腓理徒，
verses.textEnNiv: Their teaching will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
verses.textEnEsv: and their talk will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
verses.textEnNkjv: And their message will spread like cancer. Hymenaeus and Philetus are of this sort,
verses.textEnNlt: This kind of talk spreads like cancer, as in the case of Hymenaeus and Philetus.
verses.textEnNasb: and their talk will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
verses.textEn: Their teaching will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

verses.textZh: 他们偏离了真道，说复活的事已经过去了，于是毁坏了一些人的信心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们偏离了真道，说复活的事已经过去了，于是毁坏了一些人的信心。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们偏离了真道，说复活的事已过，就败坏好些人的信心。
verses.textEnNiv: who have departed from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already taken place, and they destroy the faith of some.
verses.textEnEsv: who have swerved from the truth, saying that the resurrection has already happened. They are upsetting the faith of some.
verses.textEnNkjv: who have strayed concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past; and they overthrow the faith of some.
verses.textEnNlt: They have left the path of truth, claiming that the resurrection of the dead has already occurred; in this way, they have turned some people away from the faith.
verses.textEnNasb: men who have gone astray from the truth, claiming that the resurrection has already taken place; and they are jeopardizing the faith of some.
verses.textEn: who have departed from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already taken place, and they destroy the faith of some.

verses.textZh: 然而，神坚固的根基已经立定，上面刻着这样的印："主认识属于他的人"和"凡称呼主名的人都应当离开不义"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，神坚固的根基已经立定，上面刻着这样的印："主认识属于他的人"和"凡称呼主名的人都应当离开不义"。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，神坚固的根基立住了；上面有这印记说：「主认识谁是他的人」；又说：「凡称呼主名的人总要离开不义。」
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, God’s solid foundation stands firm, sealed with this inscription: "The Lord knows those who are his," and, "Everyone who confesses the name of the Lord must turn away from wickedness."
verses.textEnEsv: But God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: "The Lord knows those who are his," and, "Let everyone who names the name of the Lord depart from iniquity."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the solid foundation of God stands, having this seal: "The Lord knows those who are His," and, "Let everyone who names the name of Christ depart from iniquity."
verses.textEnNlt: But God’s truth stands firm like a foundation stone with this inscription: "The Lord knows those who are his," and "All who belong to the Lord must turn away from evil."
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, the firm foundation of God stands, having this seal: "The Lord knows those who are His;" and, "Everyone who names the name of the Lord is to keep away from wickedness."
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, God’s solid foundation stands firm, sealed with this inscription: "The Lord knows those who are his," and, "Everyone who confesses the name of the Lord must turn away from wickedness."

verses.textZh: 在富贵人的家里 ，不但有金器、银器，也有木器、瓦器；有贵重的，也有卑贱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在富贵人的家里 ，不但有金器、银器，也有木器、瓦器；有贵重的，也有卑贱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在大户人家，不但有金器银器，也有木器瓦器；有作为贵重的，有作为卑贱的。
verses.textEnNiv: In a large house there are articles not only of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay; some are for special purposes and some for common use.
verses.textEnEsv: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and silver but also of wood and clay, some for honorable use, some for dishonorable.
verses.textEnNkjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay, some for honor and some for dishonor.
verses.textEnNlt: In a wealthy home some utensils are made of gold and silver, and some are made of wood and clay. The expensive utensils are used for special occasions, and the cheap ones are for everyday use.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in a large house there are not only gold and silver implements, but also implements of wood and of earthenware, and some are for honor while others are for dishonor.
verses.textEn: In a large house there are articles not only of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay; some are for special purposes and some for common use.

verses.textZh: 人若自洁，离开卑贱的事，就必作贵重的器皿，成为圣洁，合主使用，预备行各样的善事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若自洁，离开卑贱的事，就必作贵重的器皿，成为圣洁，合主使用，预备行各样的善事。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若自洁，脱离卑贱的事，就必作贵重的器皿，成为圣洁，合乎主用，预备行各样的善事。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who cleanse themselves from the latter will be instruments for special purposes, made holy, useful to the Master and prepared to do any good work.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, if anyone cleanses himself from what is dishonorable, he will be a vessel for honorable use, set apart as holy, useful to the master of the house, ready for every good work.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore if anyone cleanses himself from the latter, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified and useful for the Master, prepared for every good work.
verses.textEnNlt: If you keep yourself pure, you will be a special utensil for honorable use. Your life will be clean, and you will be ready for the Master to use you for every good work.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, if anyone cleanses himself from these things, he will be an implement for honor, sanctified, useful to the Master, prepared for every good work.
verses.textEn: Those who cleanse themselves from the latter will be instruments for special purposes, made holy, useful to the Master and prepared to do any good work.

verses.textZh: 你应当逃避年轻人的私欲，要和那些以清洁的心求告主的人，一同追求公义、信心、爱心、和平。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你应当逃避年轻人的私欲，要和那些以清洁的心求告主的人，一同追求公义、信心、爱心、和平。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要逃避少年的私欲，同那清心祷告主的人追求公义、信德、仁爱、和平。
verses.textEnNiv: Flee the evil desires of youth and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace, along with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.textEnEsv: So flee youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, along with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Flee also youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Run from anything that stimulates youthful lusts. Instead, pursue righteous living, faithfulness, love, and peace. Enjoy the companionship of those who call on the Lord with pure hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: Now flee from youthful lusts and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
verses.textEn: Flee the evil desires of youth and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace, along with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

verses.textZh: 你要拒绝愚蠢无知的问难；你知道这些事会引起争论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要拒绝愚蠢无知的问难；你知道这些事会引起争论。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有那愚拙无学问的辩论，总要弃绝，因为知道这等事是起争竞的。
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t have anything to do with foolish and stupid arguments, because you know they produce quarrels.
verses.textEnEsv: Have nothing to do with foolish, ignorant controversies; you know that they breed quarrels.
verses.textEnNkjv: But avoid foolish and ignorant disputes, knowing that they generate strife.
verses.textEnNlt: Again I say, don’t get involved in foolish, ignorant arguments that only start fights.
verses.textEnNasb: But refuse foolish and ignorant speculations, knowing that they produce quarrels.
verses.textEn: Don’t have anything to do with foolish and stupid arguments, because you know they produce quarrels.

verses.textZh: 但主的仆人却不可争论，总要待人温和，善于教导，存心忍耐，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但主的仆人却不可争论，总要待人温和，善于教导，存心忍耐，
verses.textZhCuv: 然而主的仆人不可争竞，只要温温和和地待众人，善于教导，存心忍耐，
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord’s servant must not be quarrelsome but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, not resentful.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord’s servant must not be quarrelsome but kind to everyone, able to teach, patiently enduring evil,
verses.textEnNkjv: And a servant of the Lord must not quarrel but be gentle to all, able to teach, patient,
verses.textEnNlt: A servant of the Lord must not quarrel but must be kind to everyone, be able to teach, and be patient with difficult people.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord’s bond-servant must not be quarrelsome, but be kind to all, skillful in teaching, patient when wronged,
verses.textEn: And the Lord’s servant must not be quarrelsome but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, not resentful.

verses.textZh: 以温柔劝导那些对抗的人，或许神给他们悔改的心，可以认识真理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以温柔劝导那些对抗的人，或许神给他们悔改的心，可以认识真理。
verses.textZhCuv: 用温柔劝戒那抵挡的人；或者神给他们悔改的心，可以明白真道，
verses.textEnNiv: Opponents must be gently instructed, in the hope that God will grant them repentance leading them to a knowledge of the truth,
verses.textEnEsv: correcting his opponents with gentleness. God may perhaps grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth,
verses.textEnNkjv: in humility correcting those who are in opposition, if God perhaps will grant them repentance, so that they may know the truth,
verses.textEnNlt: Gently instruct those who oppose the truth. Perhaps God will change those people’s hearts, and they will learn the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: with gentleness correcting those who are in opposition, if perhaps God may grant them repentance leading to the knowledge of the truth,
verses.textEn: Opponents must be gently instructed, in the hope that God will grant them repentance leading them to a knowledge of the truth,

verses.textZh: 他们虽然曾经被魔鬼掳去，随从他的意思而行，或许也能醒悟过来，脱离魔鬼的陷阱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们虽然曾经被魔鬼掳去，随从他的意思而行，或许也能醒悟过来，脱离魔鬼的陷阱。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫他们这已经被魔鬼任意掳去的，可以醒悟，脱离他的网罗。
verses.textEnNiv: and that they will come to their senses and escape from the trap of the devil, who has taken them captive to do his will.
verses.textEnEsv: and they may come to their senses and escape from the snare of the devil, after being captured by him to do his will.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that they may come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, having been taken captive by him to do his will.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will come to their senses and escape from the devil’s trap. For they have been held captive by him to do whatever he wants.
verses.textEnNasb: and they may come to their senses and escape from the snare of the devil, having been held captive by him to do his will.
verses.textEn: and that they will come to their senses and escape from the trap of the devil, who has taken them captive to do his will.

verses.textZh: 你应当知道，末后的日子必有艰难的时期来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你应当知道，末后的日子必有艰难的时期来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 你该知道，末世必有危险的日子来到。
verses.textEnNiv: But mark this: There will be terrible times in the last days.
verses.textEnEsv: But understand this, that in the last days there will come times of difficulty.
verses.textEnNkjv: But know this, that in the last days perilous times will come:
verses.textEnNlt: You should know this, Timothy, that in the last days there will be very difficult times.
verses.textEnNasb: But realize this, that in the last days difficult times will come.
verses.textEn: But mark this: There will be terrible times in the last days.

verses.textZh: 那时，人会专爱自己、贪爱钱财、自夸、高傲、亵渎、悖逆父母、忘恩负义、不圣洁、
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，人会专爱自己、贪爱钱财、自夸、高傲、亵渎、悖逆父母、忘恩负义、不圣洁、
verses.textZhCuv: 因为那时，人要专顾自己，贪爱钱财，自夸，狂傲，谤，违背父母，忘恩负义，心不圣洁，
verses.textEnNiv: People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, proud, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
verses.textEnEsv: For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, proud, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
verses.textEnNkjv: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.textEnNlt: For people will love only themselves and their money. They will be boastful and proud, scoffing at God, disobedient to their parents, and ungrateful. They will consider nothing sacred.
verses.textEnNasb: For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, slanderers, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy,
verses.textEn: People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, proud, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,

verses.textZh: 没有亲情、不肯和解、恶言中伤、不能自律、横蛮凶暴、不爱良善、
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有亲情、不肯和解、恶言中伤、不能自律、横蛮凶暴、不爱良善、
verses.textZhCuv: 无亲情，不解怨，好说谗言，不能自约，性情凶暴，不爱良善，
verses.textEnNiv: without love, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not lovers of the good,
verses.textEnEsv: heartless, unappeasable, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not loving good,
verses.textEnNkjv: unloving, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, brutal, despisers of good,
verses.textEnNlt: They will be unloving and unforgiving; they will slander others and have no self-control. They will be cruel and hate what is good.
verses.textEnNasb: unloving, irreconcilable, malicious gossips, without self-control, brutal, haters of good,
verses.textEn: without love, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not lovers of the good,

verses.textZh: 卖主卖友、容易冲动、傲慢自大、爱享乐过于爱神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 卖主卖友、容易冲动、傲慢自大、爱享乐过于爱神，
verses.textZhCuv: 卖主卖友，任意妄为，自高自大，爱宴乐，不爱神，
verses.textEnNiv: treacherous, rash, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God—
verses.textEnEsv: treacherous, reckless, swollen with conceit, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: traitors, headstrong, haughty, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
verses.textEnNlt: They will betray their friends, be reckless, be puffed up with pride, and love pleasure rather than God.
verses.textEnNasb: treacherous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
verses.textEn: treacherous, rash, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God—

verses.textZh: 有敬虔的形式，却否定敬虔的能力；这些人你应当避开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有敬虔的形式，却否定敬虔的能力；这些人你应当避开。
verses.textZhCuv: 有敬虔的外貌，却背了敬虔的实意；这等人你要躲开。
verses.textEnNiv: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Have nothing to do with such people.
verses.textEnEsv: having the appearance of godliness, but denying its power. Avoid such people.
verses.textEnNkjv: having a form of godliness but denying its power. And from such people turn away!
verses.textEnNlt: They will act religious, but they will reject the power that could make them godly. Stay away from people like that!
verses.textEnNasb: holding to a form of godliness although they have denied its power; avoid such people as these.
verses.textEn: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Have nothing to do with such people.

verses.textZh: 他们中间有人潜入别人的家里，操纵无知的妇女。这些妇女被罪压住，又被各种私欲拖累，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间有人潜入别人的家里，操纵无知的妇女。这些妇女被罪压住，又被各种私欲拖累，
verses.textZhCuv: 那偷进人家、牢笼无知妇女的，正是这等人。这些妇女担负罪恶，被各样的私欲引诱，
verses.textEnNiv: They are the kind who worm their way into homes and gain control over gullible women, who are loaded down with sins and are swayed by all kinds of evil desires,
verses.textEnEsv: For among them are those who creep into households and capture weak women, burdened with sins and led astray by various passions,
verses.textEnNkjv: For of this sort are those who creep into households and make captives of gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
verses.textEnNlt: They are the kind who work their way into people’s homes and win the confidence of vulnerable women who are burdened with the guilt of sin and controlled by various desires.
verses.textEnNasb: For among them are those who slip into households and captivate weak women weighed down with sins, led on by various impulses,
verses.textEn: They are the kind who worm their way into homes and gain control over gullible women, who are loaded down with sins and are swayed by all kinds of evil desires,

verses.textZh: 虽然常常学习，总不能充分明白真理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然常常学习，总不能充分明白真理。
verses.textZhCuv: 常常学习，终久不能明白真道。
verses.textEnNiv: always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: always learning and never able to arrive at a knowledge of the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: (Such women are forever following new teachings, but they are never able to understand the truth.)
verses.textEnNasb: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.textEn: always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.

verses.textZh: 从前阎儡和阎悖怎样反对摩西，这些人也怎样反对真理。他们的心思败坏，信仰也经不起考验。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前阎儡和阎悖怎样反对摩西，这些人也怎样反对真理。他们的心思败坏，信仰也经不起考验。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前雅尼和佯庇怎样敌挡摩西，这等人也怎样敌挡真道。他们的心地坏了，在真道上是可废弃的。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these teachers oppose the truth. They are men of depraved minds, who, as far as the faith is concerned, are rejected.
verses.textEnEsv: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these men also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind and disqualified regarding the faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres resisted Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, disapproved concerning the faith;
verses.textEnNlt: These teachers oppose the truth just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses. They have depraved minds and a counterfeit faith.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these men also oppose the truth, men of depraved mind, worthless in regard to the faith.
verses.textEn: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these teachers oppose the truth. They are men of depraved minds, who, as far as the faith is concerned, are rejected.

verses.textZh: 然而他们不能再这样下去了，因为他们的愚昧终必在众人面前显露出来，好象那两个人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而他们不能再这样下去了，因为他们的愚昧终必在众人面前显露出来，好象那两个人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而他们不能再这样敌挡；因为他们的愚昧必在众人面前显露出来，像那二人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But they will not get very far because, as in the case of those men, their folly will be clear to everyone.
verses.textEnEsv: But they will not get very far, for their folly will be plain to all, as was that of those two men.
verses.textEnNkjv: but they will progress no further, for their folly will be manifest to all, as theirs also was.
verses.textEnNlt: But they won’t get away with this for long. Someday everyone will recognize what fools they are, just as with Jannes and Jambres.
verses.textEnNasb: But they will not make further progress; for their foolishness will be obvious to all, just as was that also of Jannes and Jambres.
verses.textEn: But they will not get very far because, as in the case of those men, their folly will be clear to everyone.

verses.textZh: 但是，你已经了解我的教训、品行、志向、信心、宽容、爱心和忍耐，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，你已经了解我的教训、品行、志向、信心、宽容、爱心和忍耐，
verses.textZhCuv: 但你已经服从了我的教训、品行、志向、信心、宽容、爱心、忍耐，
verses.textEnNiv: You, however, know all about my teaching, my way of life, my purpose, faith, patience, love, endurance,
verses.textEnEsv: You, however, have followed my teaching, my conduct, my aim in life, my faith, my patience, my love, my steadfastness,
verses.textEnNkjv: But you have carefully followed my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, perseverance,
verses.textEnNlt: But you, Timothy, certainly know what I teach, and how I live, and what my purpose in life is. You know my faith, my patience, my love, and my endurance.
verses.textEnNasb: Now you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, perseverance,
verses.textEn: You, however, know all about my teaching, my way of life, my purpose, faith, patience, love, endurance,

verses.textZh: 以及我在安提阿、以哥念、路司得所受的苦和迫害。我所忍受的是怎样的迫害；这一切主都救我脱离了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及我在安提阿、以哥念、路司得所受的苦和迫害。我所忍受的是怎样的迫害；这一切主都救我脱离了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以及我在安提阿、以哥念、路司得所遭遇的逼迫、苦难。我所忍受是何等的逼迫；但从这一切苦难中，主都把我救出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: persecutions, sufferings—what kinds of things happened to me in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, the persecutions I endured. Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
verses.textEnEsv: my persecutions and sufferings that happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, and at Lystra—which persecutions I endured; yet from them all the Lord rescued me.
verses.textEnNkjv: persecutions, afflictions, which happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra—what persecutions I endured. And out of them all the Lord delivered me.
verses.textEnNlt: You know how much persecution and suffering I have endured. You know all about how I was persecuted in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra—but the Lord rescued me from all of it.
verses.textEnNasb: persecutions, and sufferings, such as happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, and at Lystra; what persecutions I endured, and out of them all the Lord rescued me!
verses.textEn: persecutions, sufferings—what kinds of things happened to me in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, the persecutions I endured. Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.

verses.textZh: 其实，所有立志在基督耶稣里过敬虔生活的，都必遭受迫害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实，所有立志在基督耶稣里过敬虔生活的，都必遭受迫害。
verses.textZhCuv: 不但如此，凡立志在基督耶稣里敬虔度日的也都要受逼迫。
verses.textEnNiv: In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed, all who desire to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, and everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, all who want to live in a godly way in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
verses.textEn: In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,

verses.textZh: 但恶人和骗子必越来越坏，他们欺骗人，也必受欺骗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但恶人和骗子必越来越坏，他们欺骗人，也必受欺骗。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是作恶的和迷惑人的，必越久越恶，他欺哄人，也被人欺哄。
verses.textEnNiv: while evildoers and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
verses.textEnEsv: while evil people and impostors will go on from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
verses.textEnNkjv: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
verses.textEnNlt: But evil people and impostors will flourish. They will deceive others and will themselves be deceived.
verses.textEnNasb: But evil people and impostors will proceed from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
verses.textEn: while evildoers and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

verses.textZh: 你应当遵守所学和确信的；你知道是跟谁学的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你应当遵守所学和确信的；你知道是跟谁学的，
verses.textZhCuv: 但你所学习的，所确信的，要存在心里；因为你知道是跟谁学的，
verses.textEnNiv: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have become convinced of, because you know those from whom you learned it,
verses.textEnEsv: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have firmly believed, knowing from whom you learned it
verses.textEnNkjv: But you must continue in the things which you have learned and been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them,
verses.textEnNlt: But you must remain faithful to the things you have been taught. You know they are true, for you know you can trust those who taught you.
verses.textEnNasb: You, however, continue in the things you have learned and become convinced of, knowing from whom you have learned them,
verses.textEn: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have become convinced of, because you know those from whom you learned it,

verses.textZh: 并且知道自己从小就明白圣经，这圣经能够使你有智慧，可以因信基督耶稣得着救恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且知道自己从小就明白圣经，这圣经能够使你有智慧，可以因信基督耶稣得着救恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且知道你是从小明白圣经，这圣经能使你因信基督耶稣，有得救的智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: and how from infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: and how from childhood you have been acquainted with the sacred writings, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that from childhood you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: You have been taught the holy Scriptures from childhood, and they have given you the wisdom to receive the salvation that comes by trusting in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: and that from childhood you have known the sacred writings which are able to give you the wisdom that leads to salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: and how from infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 全部圣经都是神所默示的，在教训、责备、矫正和公义的训练各方面，都是有益的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 全部圣经都是神所默示的，在教训、责备、矫正和公义的训练各方面，都是有益的，
verses.textZhCuv: 圣经都是神所默示的 ，于教训、督责、使人归正、教导人学义都是有益的，
verses.textEnNiv: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness,
verses.textEnEsv: All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
verses.textEnNkjv: All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness,
verses.textEnNlt: All Scripture is inspired by God and is useful to teach us what is true and to make us realize what is wrong in our lives. It corrects us when we are wrong and teaches us to do what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: All Scripture is inspired by God and beneficial for teaching, for rebuke, for correction, for training in righteousness;
verses.textEn: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness,

verses.textZh: 为要使属神的人装备好，可以完成各样的善工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要使属神的人装备好，可以完成各样的善工。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫属神的人得以完全，预备行各样的善事。
verses.textEnNiv: so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.
verses.textEnEsv: that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
verses.textEnNlt: God uses it to prepare and equip his people to do every good work.
verses.textEnNasb: so that the man or woman of God may be fully capable, equipped for every good work.
verses.textEn: so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.

verses.textZh: 我在神面前，并且在那将要审判活人死人的基督耶稣面前，凭着他的显现和国度叮嘱你：
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在神面前，并且在那将要审判活人死人的基督耶稣面前，凭着他的显现和国度叮嘱你：
verses.textZhCuv: 我在神面前，并在将来审判活人死人的基督耶稣面前，凭着他的显现和他的国度嘱咐你：
verses.textEnNiv: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of his appearing and his kingdom, I give you this charge:
verses.textEnEsv: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who is to judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:
verses.textEnNkjv: I charge you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at His appearing and His kingdom:
verses.textEnNlt: I solemnly urge you in the presence of God and Christ Jesus, who will someday judge the living and the dead when he comes to set up his Kingdom:
verses.textEnNasb: I solemnly exhort you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who is to judge the living and the dead, and by His appearing and His kingdom:
verses.textEn: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of his appearing and his kingdom, I give you this charge:

verses.textZh: 务要传道；无论时机是否适合，都要常作准备；要以多方的忍耐和教训责备人、警戒人、劝勉人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 务要传道；无论时机是否适合，都要常作准备；要以多方的忍耐和教训责备人、警戒人、劝勉人。
verses.textZhCuv: 务要传道，无论得时不得时总要专心，并用百般的忍耐、各样的教训责备人，警戒人，劝勉人。
verses.textEnNiv: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage—with great patience and careful instruction.
verses.textEnEsv: preach the word; be ready in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort, with complete patience and teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: Preach the word! Be ready in season and out of season. Convince, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.
verses.textEnNlt: Preach the word of God. Be prepared, whether the time is favorable or not. Patiently correct, rebuke, and encourage your people with good teaching.
verses.textEnNasb: preach the word; be ready in season and out of season; correct, rebuke, and exhort, with great patience and instruction.
verses.textEn: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage—with great patience and careful instruction.

verses.textZh: 因为时候快要到了，人必容不下纯正的道理，反而耳朵发痒，随着自己的私欲，增添许多教师，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为时候快要到了，人必容不下纯正的道理，反而耳朵发痒，随着自己的私欲，增添许多教师，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为时候要到，人必厌烦纯正的道理，耳朵发痒，就随从自己的情欲，增添好些师傅，
verses.textEnNiv: For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.
verses.textEnEsv: For the time is coming when people will not endure sound teaching, but having itching ears they will accumulate for themselves teachers to suit their own passions,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine, but according to their own desires, because they have itching ears, they will heap up for themselves teachers;
verses.textEnNlt: For a time is coming when people will no longer listen to sound and wholesome teaching. They will follow their own desires and will look for teachers who will tell them whatever their itching ears want to hear.
verses.textEnNasb: For the time will come when they will not tolerate sound doctrine; but wanting to have their ears tickled, they will accumulate for themselves teachers in accordance with their own desires,
verses.textEn: For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.

verses.textZh: 而且转离不听真理，反倒趋向无稽之谈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且转离不听真理，反倒趋向无稽之谈。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且掩耳不听真道，偏向荒渺的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: They will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
verses.textEnEsv: and will turn away from listening to the truth and wander off into myths.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they will turn their ears away from the truth, and be turned aside to fables.
verses.textEnNlt: They will reject the truth and chase after myths.
verses.textEnNasb: and they will turn their ears away from the truth and will turn aside to myths.
verses.textEn: They will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.

verses.textZh: 你却要凡事谨慎，忍受磨难、作传福音者的工作，完成你的职务。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你却要凡事谨慎，忍受磨难、作传福音者的工作，完成你的职务。
verses.textZhCuv: 你却要凡事谨慎，忍受苦难，做传道的工夫，尽你的职分。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, keep your head in all situations, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, discharge all the duties of your ministry.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for you, always be sober-minded, endure suffering, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you be watchful in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
verses.textEnNlt: But you should keep a clear mind in every situation. Don’t be afraid of suffering for the Lord. Work at telling others the Good News, and fully carry out the ministry God has given you.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, use self-restraint in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
verses.textEn: But you, keep your head in all situations, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, discharge all the duties of your ministry.

verses.textZh: 我已经被浇奠；我离世的时候也到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我已经被浇奠；我离世的时候也到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我现在被浇奠，我离世的时候到了。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time for my departure is near.
verses.textEnEsv: For I am already being poured out as a drink offering, and the time of my departure has come.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am already being poured out as a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.textEnNlt: As for me, my life has already been poured out as an offering to God. The time of my death is near.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am already being poured out as a drink offering, and the time of my departure has come.
verses.textEn: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time for my departure is near.

verses.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所持的信仰我已经守住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所持的信仰我已经守住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。
verses.textEnNiv: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verses.textEnEsv: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verses.textEnNlt: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, and I have remained faithful.
verses.textEnNasb: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith;
verses.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

verses.textZh: 从此以后，有公义的冠冕为我存留，就是按公义审判的主在那日要赏给我的；不但赏给我，也赏给所有爱慕他显现的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从此以后，有公义的冠冕为我存留，就是按公义审判的主在那日要赏给我的；不但赏给我，也赏给所有爱慕他显现的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此以后，有公义的冠冕为我存留，就是按着公义审判的主到了那日要赐给我的；不但赐给我，也赐给凡爱慕他显现的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Now there is in store for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but also to all who have longed for his appearing.
verses.textEnEsv: Henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will award to me on that day, and not only to me but also to all who have loved his appearing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Finally, there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give to me on that Day, and not to me only but also to all who have loved His appearing.
verses.textEnNlt: And now the prize awaits me—the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give me on the day of his return. And the prize is not just for me but for all who eagerly look forward to his appearing.
verses.textEnNasb: in the future there is reserved for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day; and not only to me, but also to all who have loved His appearing.
verses.textEn: Now there is in store for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but also to all who have longed for his appearing.

verses.textZh: 你要尽快到我这里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要尽快到我这里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要赶紧地到我这里来。
verses.textEnNiv: Do your best to come to me quickly,
verses.textEnEsv: Do your best to come to me soon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be diligent to come to me quickly;
verses.textEnNlt: Timothy, please come as soon as you can.
verses.textEnNasb: Make every effort to come to me soon;
verses.textEn: Do your best to come to me quickly,

verses.textZh: 因为底马贪爱现今的世界，就离弃我到帖撒罗尼迦去了。革勒士去了加拉太，提多去了达马太。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为底马贪爱现今的世界，就离弃我到帖撒罗尼迦去了。革勒士去了加拉太，提多去了达马太。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为底马贪爱现今的世界，就离弃我往帖撒罗尼迦去了；革勒士往加拉太去；提多往挞马太去；
verses.textEnNiv: for Demas, because he loved this world, has deserted me and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
verses.textEnEsv: For Demas, in love with this present world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
verses.textEnNkjv: for Demas has forsaken me, having loved this present world, and has departed for Thessalonica—Crescens for Galatia, Titus for Dalmatia.
verses.textEnNlt: Demas has deserted me because he loves the things of this life and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
verses.textEnNasb: for Demas, having loved this present world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica; Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
verses.textEn: for Demas, because he loved this world, has deserted me and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

verses.textZh: 只有路加在我这里。你找到了马可，就把他带来，因为他在圣工上对我有益。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有路加在我这里。你找到了马可，就把他带来，因为他在圣工上对我有益。
verses.textZhCuv: 独有路加在我这里。你来的时候，要把马可带来，因为他在传道 的事上于我有益处。
verses.textEnNiv: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is helpful to me in my ministry.
verses.textEnEsv: Luke alone is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, for he is very useful to me for ministry.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for ministry.
verses.textEnNlt: Only Luke is with me. Bring Mark with you when you come, for he will be helpful to me in my ministry.
verses.textEnNasb: Only Luke is with me. Take along Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
verses.textEn: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is helpful to me in my ministry.

verses.textZh: 我差派了推基古到以弗所去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我差派了推基古到以弗所去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我已经打发推基古往以弗所去。
verses.textEnNiv: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Tychicus I have sent to Ephesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Tychicus I have sent to Ephesus.
verses.textEnNlt: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
verses.textEnNasb: But I have sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
verses.textEn: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

verses.textZh: 我在特罗亚留在加布那里的外衣，你来的时候要把它带来，还有那些书卷，特别是那些羊皮卷，也要带来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在特罗亚留在加布那里的外衣，你来的时候要把它带来，还有那些书卷，特别是那些羊皮卷，也要带来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在特罗亚留于加布的那件外衣，你来的时候可以带来，那些书也要带来，更要紧的是那些皮卷。
verses.textEnNiv: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
verses.textEnEsv: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, also the books, and above all the parchments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.
verses.textEnNlt: When you come, be sure to bring the coat I left with Carpus at Troas. Also bring my books, and especially my papers.
verses.textEnNasb: When you come, bring the overcoat which I left at Troas with Carpus, and the books, especially the parchments.
verses.textEn: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.

verses.textZh: 铜匠亚历山大作了许多恶事陷害我，主必按着他所行的报应他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 铜匠亚历山大作了许多恶事陷害我，主必按着他所行的报应他。
verses.textZhCuv: 铜匠亚历山大多多地害我；主必照他所行的报应他。
verses.textEnNiv: Alexander the metalworker did me a great deal of harm. The Lord will repay him for what he has done.
verses.textEnEsv: Alexander the coppersmith did me great harm; the Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much harm. May the Lord repay him according to his works.
verses.textEnNlt: Alexander the coppersmith did me much harm, but the Lord will judge him for what he has done.
verses.textEnNasb: Alexander the coppersmith did me great harm; the Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
verses.textEn: Alexander the metalworker did me a great deal of harm. The Lord will repay him for what he has done.

verses.textZh: 你也要提防他，因为他极力抵挡我们的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要提防他，因为他极力抵挡我们的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也要防备他，因为他极力敌挡了我们的话。
verses.textEnNiv: You too should be on your guard against him, because he strongly opposed our message.
verses.textEnEsv: Beware of him yourself, for he strongly opposed our message.
verses.textEnNkjv: You also must beware of him, for he has greatly resisted our words.
verses.textEnNlt: Be careful of him, for he fought against everything we said.
verses.textEnNasb: Be on guard against him yourself too, for he vigorously opposed our teaching.
verses.textEn: You too should be on your guard against him, because he strongly opposed our message.

verses.textZh: 我第一次申辩的时候，没有一个人支持我，反而离弃我。但愿这罪不要归在他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我第一次申辩的时候，没有一个人支持我，反而离弃我。但愿这罪不要归在他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我初次申诉，没有人前来帮助，竟都离弃我；但愿这罪不归与他们。
verses.textEnNiv: At my first defense, no one came to my support, but everyone deserted me. May it not be held against them.
verses.textEnEsv: At my first defense no one came to stand by me, but all deserted me. May it not be charged against them!
verses.textEnNkjv: At my first defense no one stood with me, but all forsook me. May it not be charged against them.
verses.textEnNlt: The first time I was brought before the judge, no one came with me. Everyone abandoned me. May it not be counted against them.
verses.textEnNasb: At my first defense no one supported me, but all deserted me; may it not be counted against them.
verses.textEn: At my first defense, no one came to my support, but everyone deserted me. May it not be held against them.

verses.textZh: 然而主站在我旁边，加给我力量，使福音的信息借着我尽都传开，万国的人都可以听见；他并且把我从狮子口中救出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而主站在我旁边，加给我力量，使福音的信息借着我尽都传开，万国的人都可以听见；他并且把我从狮子口中救出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有主站在我旁边，加给我力量，使福音被我尽都传明，叫外邦人都听见；我也从狮子口里被救出来。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord stood at my side and gave me strength, so that through me the message might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear it. And I was delivered from the lion’s mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear it. So I was rescued from the lion’s mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, so that the message might be preached fully through me, and that all the Gentiles might hear. Also I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord stood with me and gave me strength so that I might preach the Good News in its entirety for all the Gentiles to hear. And he rescued me from certain death.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, so that through me the proclamation might be fully accomplished, and that all the Gentiles might hear; and I was rescued out of the lion’s mouth.
verses.textEn: But the Lord stood at my side and gave me strength, so that through me the message might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear it. And I was delivered from the lion’s mouth.

verses.textZh: 主必救我脱离一切邪恶的事，也必救我进入他天上的国。愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主必救我脱离一切邪恶的事，也必救我进入他天上的国。愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 主必救我脱离诸般的凶恶，也必救我进他的天国。愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will rescue me from every evil attack and will bring me safely to his heavenly kingdom. To him be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will rescue me from every evil deed and bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and preserve me for His heavenly kingdom. To Him be glory forever and ever. Amen!
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, and the Lord will deliver me from every evil attack and will bring me safely into his heavenly Kingdom. All glory to God forever and ever! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will rescue me from every evil deed, and will bring me safely to His heavenly kingdom; to Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEn: The Lord will rescue me from every evil attack and will bring me safely to his heavenly kingdom. To him be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.textZh: 问候百基拉、亚居拉和阿尼色弗一家的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候百基拉、亚居拉和阿尼色弗一家的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 问百基拉、亚居拉，和阿尼色弗一家的人安。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.textEnNlt: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and those living in the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.textEn: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.

verses.textZh: 以拉都在哥林多住下了。特罗非摩病了，我就留他在米利都。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以拉都在哥林多住下了。特罗非摩病了，我就留他在米利都。
verses.textZhCuv: 以拉都在哥林多住下了。特罗非摩病了，我就留他在米利都。
verses.textEnNiv: Erastus stayed in Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.
verses.textEnEsv: Erastus remained at Corinth, and I left Trophimus, who was ill, at Miletus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Erastus stayed in Corinth, but Trophimus I have left in Miletus sick.
verses.textEnNlt: Erastus stayed at Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick at Miletus.
verses.textEnNasb: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus sick at Miletus.
verses.textEn: Erastus stayed in Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.

verses.textZh: 你要赶紧在冬天以前到我这里来。友布罗、布田、利奴、革老底亚和众弟兄都问候你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要赶紧在冬天以前到我这里来。友布罗、布田、利奴、革老底亚和众弟兄都问候你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要赶紧在冬天以前到我这里来。有友布罗、布田、利奴、革老底亚，和众弟兄都问你安。
verses.textEnNiv: Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus greets you, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia and all the brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnEsv: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus sends greetings to you, as do Pudens and Linus and Claudia and all the brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do your utmost to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, as well as Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: Make every effort to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, also Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers and sisters.
verses.textEn: Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus greets you, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia and all the brothers and sisters.

verses.textZh: 主与你同在。愿恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主与你同在。愿恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿主与你的灵同在！愿恩惠常与你们同在！
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord be with your spirit. And may his grace be with all of you.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.
verses.textEn: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
